Erin is a saintess blessed with extraordinary healing powers. Just as she is about to become engaged to the crown prince, she is stripped of her title as saintess for unjust reasons and exiled from the royal capital. With nowhere to go, Erin wanders into an unfamiliar forest, where she encounters an injured phantom beast and a mysterious, beautiful young man named Kratos. 218093.description:
Nonki na Tousan is an early manga comic strip by Asou Yutaka, first published in 1923, in the newspaper Hochi Shinbun.

The strip follows the antics created by the main character, Nonkina Tousan (Easygoing Daddy) and his partner Tonari no Taishou (隣のタイショウ). Inspired by American comics, especially Bringing Up Father, it was one of the pioneering yonkoma, becoming a success, generating a number of merchandising items and adaptations to animated shorts and feature films.

(Source: Wikipedia)

218094.description:
A manga depicting the life of Bonji, the son of Nonki Tousan, after he graduates from college.

During the early Showa period when the series was serialized, the Showa Depression made it difficult even for highly educated people to find employment. The phrase “I graduated from college, but…” became a popular catchphrase, and a film of the same name was even produced. Against this backdrop, “a pure, straightforward, and lovable young man,” “timid and shy” struggles through job hunting and life as a salaryman.

(Source: Wikipedia, translated)

Since no one else seems to be able to see it, Tsukishima begins to suspect that he might be losing his mind. Then, by a twist of fate, he accidentally touches the object floating above Kirara’s head, and their relationship begins to take shape.

The person she encounters is Kanna, a Dispeller who can undo the magic that is the symbol of human progress and is feared as a heretic by the world. Their meeting sets in motion the judgment of the sins arbored by the greedy magicians.

An epic fantasy saga that exposes the truth of magical society!

Rumi Sakai, whose father is an actor, spends her days dreaming of stardom, endlessly cycling through part-time jobs, lessons, and auditions. However, with no sign of success, she is easily overtaken by her classmate Sanae Nonomura following an unfortunate accident, leaving her in despair. Just then, an elderly woman reading fortunes in a back alley beckons her over. The fortune-teller reveals that Rumi Sakai missed her chance because of Sanae's scheme and urges her to take revenge.

(Source: Kaiki Manga no Anagura, translated)

218101.description:
After losing her parents in a fire, Satsuki Ninomiya was taken in by her wealthy uncle, but she was treated coldly. This was because her father had left home—effectively disowned—to marry the daughter of a commoner. The hostility from her aunt and her aunt’s daughter, Aiko, was particularly harsh, and Satsuki felt she had no place to belong, neither at home nor at school. One day, she purchased an antique Western chair at a bargain price from an antique shop. In fact, this chair was a historic piece once used by Marie Antoinette herself, and it possessed the power to grant its owner’s wishes.

While sitting in the chair, Satsuki had a dream about her parents. Prompted by that dream, she learned that her parents’ deaths were not the result of an accidental fire, but murder. Relying on the last painting her father created, she begins searching for the killer. Gradually, the secrets surrounding her parents’ deaths are revealed, but the people she suspects of being the killer die one after another.

“Who, exactly, killed Satsuki’s parents…?”

(Source: Kaiki Manga no Anagura, translated)

Despite this, Ha-Ru cannot bring herself to give up on Se-Gye. Then one day, Se-Gye begins to confront the feelings he has been trying so hard to ignore, and a change comes over their relationship.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Explorers who came to climb the Masinmok brought along slaves called “Lumberjacks” to take on the dangers in their place. To gain their freedom, Lumberjacks had to successfully complete 100 expeditions. Having completed 99 expeditions and with the end of his long life of slavery in sight, the young Lumberjack “Jack” embarks on his final journey.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Thirteen years ago, while he and his mother were walking along a mountain path, a carriage struck them; his mother died, and he lost all his memories except for his name. He is escorted to the Mayer family estate in by the family’s personal physician, Dr. Carmichael. According to the doctor, the Mayer dowager has apparently been losing her mind ever since she lost her only son, Gerard. She is convinced that Gerard is still alive and behaves as if he were. Mike decides to stay at the mansion to determine whether he is a member of the Meyer family. However, the Widow Meyer and her servant, Guild, treat him coldly. Furthermore, in Gerard’s room upstairs, Mike catches a glimpse of Gerard’s back—even though Gerard is supposed to be dead.

(Source: Kaiki Manga no Anagura, translated)

There's no point in apologizing now.'' Charlotte remembers her previous life after being kicked by a horse. She says that this world is an otome game that she was addicted to in her previous life, "Magic Love Academy,'' and that she is a villainess whose only option is death. The only way to avoid her death flag is to get the heroine together with her fiancé, Prince Will. Charlotte immediately tells Will to break off her engagement, but he ends up getting angry at her and she begins to receive naughty punishment...

Aysha is a mermaid who rises from the depths of the ocean to pursue the one she loves. However, her beloved’s heart belongs to another, and her love goes unrequited. Realizing she will never be loved in return, Aysha plunges a knife into the prince to avert her fate of turning into sea foam... A tale of young girls woven in the spirit of the fairy tale The Little Mermaid.

(Source: Magcomi, translated)

My favorite person is my boss! Newcomer Chika Sakurada is the office's beloved character, working flawlessly and cheerfully today as well. However, she is secretly "doing her fangirl work" on her quiet, expressionless, and never-smiling boss, Masataka Sometani! A working comedy about working hard with all your might for your favorite idol!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

218505.description:
High school girl Misumi Sawa harbors a secret she can tell no one: she gets excited whenever her best friend, Miu-chan, gets a nosebleed. Because Miu-chan is naturally prone to nosebleeds, Sawa has been secretly enjoying this aspect of their daily lives. However, one day, Miu's nosebleeds suddenly stop completely. Desperate to get her bleeding again, Sawa goes to great lengths to make it happen, but as her desires escalate, she ends up causing an irreversible incident—!

Note:
- Grand Prize winner in 64th Shounen Sirius Newcomer Awards.
- Published in Monthly Shounen Sirius 2026-10.

218506.description:
"All-out child-rearing to avoid execution! Or so I thought but somehow the entire family is all-out showering me with love?!"

The protagonist possesses Arcelia, a wicked stepmother condemned to be executed on a false charge. Her condition for survival: "Protect the family name and the children until the eldest son comes of age." Three step-children who make no secret of their hostility. Relatives scheming after the family's fortune. And the most terrifying knight commander her husband's former subordinate. In a duke's household swirling with conspiracy, she throws herself into a life-or-death mission of child-rearing and reform. At least, that was the plan. But she ends up being loved so deeply that a "quiet retirement" becomes completely impossible. "Those two are fighting over you again! But you can't go with them Mother belongs to me." From despised villainess to the object of smothering, overprotective adoration from her step-family and knights alike escape is no longer an option.

When a person loves someone, a bird is born in their heart. That is the very heart that loves that person. This is the story of people who cannot bear the weight of their love, and Bianca, who collects those birds.

(Source: Justoon, translated)

218508.description:
The ruthless yet gentle ruler Heart, the serial killer Mad Hatter, the split-personality gang boss Twins… … All of this began before the arrival of 'Alice,' when a woman stepped into the reverse harem novel 'Wonderland'.

Wonderland, a city of criminals and trash. There, she is the White Rabbit, a messenger and maintainer of order. What drives this dimension-traveler is the hope that if she helps the protagonist Alice bring the story to a close, she might be able to return to her family. However, even after Alice's arrival, the men who should have been hers fail to fulfill their roles, merely hovering around Soyoon, and their obsession and blind devotion only intensify.

218509.description:
When Grand Duke Heveruth realizes he's in love, their contract marriage is already over, and Litricia has died from her terminal illness. He then finds himself traveling back in time to the day they first met, and this time, he swears to save his wife so they can live happily ever after together.

(Source: Manta)

218510.description:
“To become an immortal, one must live a strictly ascetic life.”

Yeongsu, a white tiger beastkin who must take the immortality exam in order to become a god, begins to question his desire for divinity after falling in love with Bomi, a human woman. On the day he finally gathers the courage to visit her, Bomi becomes possessed by a frustrated god and starts seducing Yeongsu openly. Unaware of the truth, Yeongsu gradually loses his reason under Bomi’s touch.

“Then all I have to do is satisfy you, right, teacher?”

In the end, he accepts her proposal…
synonyms: The Secrets of a Possessed Woman

218511.description:
"Did you know? There's always a bigger b*tch above those who crawl."

Jeong-im, a girl raised in an underprivileged environment in a remote, suffocating seaside village, finally snaps under the relentless absurdity and boredom of her life. She steals her aunt's illicit pocket money—earned from running a decadent business—and flees to Seoul.

Determined to be reborn, she decides to spit in the face of societal standards, manipulating various men to satisfy her own primal desires as she navigates her new life...

The dominator of the North who returned after conquering the war, Fernan Kaisar.

A man perfect in every way, and the only person who remained a good memory in Yulia’s unhappy childhood. When she heard that he would become her husband, Yulia believed in the existence of God for the first time. However...

"Do as you wish if there’s something you want. Whether it’s remodeling the castle, buying jewels, or throwing parties, I don’t care. Just spare me scenes like this. I don’t want to run into you in the morning."

“Don’t die, Kaena. I can’t imagine a world without you.”

…But wasn’t this emperor supposed to be the one who kills me? One day, Kaena realizes she is a minor character in a story: the “side character who will be poisoned to death in six months by the tyrant emperor Zarius.” To survive, she secretly begins taking antidotes and devises a plan to fake her death six months later, then escape from the imperial palace. To pull this off, Kaena decides to play the role of a perfectly obedient empress, winning the trust of the cold‑hearted emperor. Yet the very man who was never supposed to open his heart to anyone gradually becomes obsessed with her instead…

I come home from work to find a warm dinner waiting for me on the table. Hold on… I live alone, don’t I? Someone is secretly sneaking into my place to cook, clean, and even do my laundry… and honestly? It’s so convenient that I’ve already gotten used to it!

In Greece, the gods are surprisingly human-like.

From the title story, "The Minotaur's Move," to a plethora of endearing tales of Greek gods, this collection is packed with fascinating stories. "I don't eat sacrifices!" says the gentle, goofy-faced Minotaur. " He's supposed to be all-knowing and all-powerful, yet he's a philanderer." says Zeus, the king of the gods. 218535.description:
Studio Metamo! is a tiny animation production company suffering from a hellish schedule due to a severe shortage of staff. Just when they are about to reach their breaking point, Studio Metamo! is offered a new employee. The members of Metamo! are excited about the arrival of their savior - however, the new employee turns out to be a demon!? Can this demon, who has lived in hell, really become the savior of Studio Metamo!? From up-and-coming animator Suzuki Haruka comes a cute and sometimes devilish anime production story!

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

218536.description:
Dai-chan is a 28-year old man who has an unremarkable life. The only thing that sets him apart is that, for some reason, a demon who speaks in Kansai dialect has taken up residence in his house. This is a warm and endearing glimpse into the daily life of an ordinary adult man and a demon who acts just like his mother.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

218537.description:
Queen Kristian was framed by her half-sister and executed at just 16 years old. Another sixteen years have passed since then, and the daughter of a duke is about to make her societal debut—her name is Tiaresia. Always close at hand is her loyal servant, growing more impatient by the day. In truth, this handsome servant is a demon, waiting to reap the rewards of a magical contract made with Tiaresia—the reincarnated former queen Kristian. Together, they plan to exact a calculated and tragic revenge.

(Source: Manga UP!)

Meiko loves her husband, Takeru, who is 13 years older than her. But she overhears him telling a friend that he wants a divorce! To win Takeru's heart, Meiko disguises herself as a beautiful woman and approaches him. As planned, they spend a sweet night together, but Takeru doesn't seem to realize that the beautiful woman is Meiko...? Does that mean he's cheating!? She worries, but Takeru reveals his possessiveness and plunges into an unexpected doting love for Meiko...!

(Source: HarperCollinsJapan, translated)

The Royal Knights, seeking abundant resources, set out on an expedition to a nameless, isolated island. But they had no idea—that the island was ruled by goblins who had undergone abnormal evolution!

Rio is terrible at romance and always gets dumped whenever she dates someone. One day, she happens to stop by a bar and unexpectedly runs into her boss, Hozumi.

At work, Hozumi is gentle and soothing, but in private, his tone and attitude are completely different. Confused, Rio is surprised when a casual remark she makes leads to him suddenly kissing her. "I'll teach you. The joy of being loved." After being sweetly and forcefully pursued, the two somehow end up dating with marriage in mind...!?

Yeo-Gyeong has it all: she’s the heiress to a wealthy family and the youngest executive ever appointed at a major Korean corporation. But behind her picture-perfect life lies a secret she can never afford to reveal. Whenever it rains, her age changes. Born with a mysterious syndrome passed down through generations, Yeo-Gyeong has spent her entire life bound by strict limitations. Then, during a seemingly endless monsoon season, a mysterious man suddenly steps into her carefully controlled world...

And for the first time, the life she’s worked so hard to protect begins to change.

(Source: Lezhin US)

When young artist Hill retreats to a quiet forest community in search of inspiration, he doesn’t realize that the territory is inhabited by animal spirits who can take human form. Nor does he expect to encounter a little deer who takes an immediate interest in him. What begins as an innocent meeting soon becomes a strange, relentless attachment as the deer follows Hill everywhere. But Hill soon discovers that his adorable admirer is far more possessive and persistent than he appears… and has already decided that Hill will be his husband.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Colson Zacher refuses to accept that his parents’ fatal car crash was an accident, but he has met obstacles every time he tries to investigate the matter. It is only by sheltering Zyne Torres, a hitman fleeing trouble of his own, that he finally gets his first real chance to find out what happened that rainy night. But with Zyne keeping secrets and mistrust seeping into their tentative alliance, will he finally be able to untangle the clues surrounding the incident?

“When I grow up, I’m going to be your bride, Mune-chan.”, with those words, his first love moved overseas.

Unable to forget her, Munenori became a university student, and he's miraculously reunited with her at university! But the girl who came back is a hardcore, gambling-obsessed gal!?

Born in a dark, damp cave, Squishy is a low-level slime with an ordinary fate ahead of him: to live and die as an insignificant monster. However, from the moment of his birth, Squishy was chosen by both magic and the system, awakening as an unusually intelligent slime alongside a livestream... At first, he didn’t feel anything, but as his senses gradually became more acute and he began to sense something was off, Dong-Ha, in a rare occurrence, manifests as a recessive Omega. 218932.description:
The story centers on high school girl Suzuka Mimori, who works as a shrine maiden at her family's shrine. One day, she gets caught up in a mysterious vortex and is transported to another world. There, she receives a letter from the enshrined deity. The god, who was once worshipped as a divine beast but is now forgotten, wants Suzuka to serve as a shrine maiden and gather worshippers again. For Suzuka to do that, the god gives her a mysterious power that lets her perform "miracles," plus fox ears and a tail (based on the god's preference?).

(Source: Anime News Network)

Ever since losing his parents in a tragic accident, Jin-sung has lived with a terrifying burden: he can see ghosts. Desperate to live a normal, quiet life, he hides his supernatural sight and struggles through the monotony of being an ordinary corporate employee. Seeking a cheap real estate investment, Jin-sung purchases a run-down, abandoned building that happens to come with an old-fashioned coffee shop on the ground floor. But he soon discovers why the property was deserted. The “customers” wandering into his café aren’t human—they are eccentric, mischievous yokai and spirits. As Jin-sung gets entangled deeper with his bizarre supernatural clientele, he is dragged into one wild, unbelievable escapade after another. Along the way, these chaotic encounters begin to unravel the truth behind his hidden “divine sight”—and the profound secret tying his own destiny to the spirit realm.

(Source: Naver, translated)

One day, the protagonist, Ha-Eon, struggles desperately to save his mother, who has become a Memorians, but under the strict measures of the rescue team, the “Memory Divers,” who were watching the situation, his mother ultimately falls into a coma. Ha-Eon then discovers that the culprit who ruined both the world and his mother is his father, whom he was separated from as a child, and ultimately decides to become a “Memory Diver” himself, diving into the “Sea of Memories” to save both the world and his mother.

After a fierce battle, he maxed out his experience points. However, for some reason, he still didn't level up. Then, in a desperate fight for his life, he earned the title "Weakest Hero," that has an extraordinary effect: "All titles you own are always active." After defeating the boss, Takeru realized he could fight using the power of titles even without leveling up. He then resolves to collect all kinds of titles and rise to the top while staying at Level 1!

Much to her chagrin, fairy doctor Lydia has failed to convince her employer, Earl Ashenbert, to call off their engagement. As much as she tries to see through his flirtations, he still seems to have her wrapped around his little finger. The appearance of the moonstone’s steward, a small fairy called a coblynau, doesn’t help—it turns out he’s a strong supporter of their union! Meanwhile, Edgar comes into possession of a cursed black diamond that is said to bring its owner great misfortune. Just how does it tie into his revenge against the Prince?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Earl and Fairy: A Cursed Diamond Imbued with Love
title.native: 伯爵と妖精　呪いのダイヤに愛をこめて
title.romaji: Hakushaku to Yousei Noroi no Daiya ni Ai wo Komete

218983.description:
Fairies may kidnap a human child and replace it with their own offspring: a changeling. Now, it seems that such an incident took place in one of the Blue Knight Earl’s territories, so Lydia, Edgar’s fairy doctor and reluctant fiancée, sets off by herself to investigate. Meanwhile, the earl is visited by some old pirate friends whom he would have preferred to have stayed in his past. They tell him that their companion, Betty, has been kidnapped by someone claiming to be the Blue Knight Earl, but this is the first Edgar’s heard of it...

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Earl and Fairy: The Changeling Princess
title.native: 伯爵と妖精　取り換えられたプリンセス

218984.description:
Fairy doctor Lydia Carlton has returned to her hometown in Scotland for a well-earned rest. Taking an extended Christmas vacation was a fine excuse, but the truth is that she feared falling in love with her employer and would-be fiancé, Edgar Ashenbert, the Earl of Ibrazel. The history of his title is a complex affair, and when she hears a mysterious rumor about the earl’s forefather, Lydia heads to the Isle of Mannan to investigate. Meanwhile, a strange girl appears before Paul, Edgar’s artist friend in London, and it soon transpires that she isn’t exactly human...

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Earl and Fairy: The Secret Behind Your Tears
title.native: 伯爵と妖精　涙の秘密をおしえて
title.romaji: Hakushaku to Yousei Namida no Himitsu wo Oshiete

218985.description:
Lydia Carlton is a girl who can see and talk to fairies. After being hired by Lord Edgar Ashenbert as a fairy doctor, she found herself engaged to him. Though it was supposed to be a measure to protect them against some persistent fairies, Edgar is taking it far more seriously than that. This volume comprises a number of short stories from the early days of Lydia’s employment. There are also tales set before the pair met, including Lydia’s first encounter with Kelpie and her first experience with heartbreak.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Earl and Fairy: Awaiting a Moonlit Elopement
title.native: 伯爵と妖精　駆け落ちは月夜を待って
title.romaji: Hakushaku to Yousei Kakeochi wa Tsukiyo wo Matte

title.native: スーパーフィッシング グランダー武蔵　Jr.バス・チャンピオン・カーニバル編
title.romaji: Super Fishing Grander Musashi: Jr. Bass Champion Carnival-hen

218987.description:
Lord Edgar Ashenbert is more eager than ever to marry his fairy doctor, Lydia Carlton. Having developed a deeper understanding of him, Lydia has found herself unable to spurn him the way she did before. Meanwhile, London has been plagued by a series of gruesome murders that seem to be linked to Edgar’s mortal enemy: the Prince. For the sake of Lydia’s safety, the earl insists that she come to stay with him at his estate. And thus the two suddenly end up living under the same roof...

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Earl and Fairy: Requiem for a Goddess
title.native: 伯爵と妖精　女神に捧ぐ鎮魂歌
title.romaji: Hakushaku to Yousei Megami ni Sasagu Chinkonka

218988.description:
Edgar has entrusted Lydia to Kelpie in order to protect her from the Prince. Although she promised to marry Edgar just before they parted, the water horse’s magic has robbed her of her memories of him. Meanwhile, a mysterious disease spreads through London’s East End. It is said that the only way to survive it is to board the Ark, a mysterious vessel moored near London Bridge. Edgar cannot help but suspect the Prince’s involvement...

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Earl and Fairy: The Bright Star of London Bridge
title.native: 伯爵と妖精　ロンドン橋に星は灯る
title.romaji: Hakushaku to Yousei London Hashi ni Hoshi wa Tomoru

title.native: 太鼓の達人 4コマ祭でドドンがドン！
title.romaji: Taiko no Tatsujin: 4-koma Matsuri de Dodon ga Don!

218990.description:
Lord Edgar Ashenbert and his fairy doctor, Lydia Carlton, are officially engaged at last. While Edgar is eager for them to be wed as soon as possible, Lydia is overwhelmed by the preparation required for marrying into nobility. Wishing to debut without fear, she swallows her anxieties and agrees to stay with a countess famed for teaching young women how to behave in upper-class society. However, when she gets there, she finds herself inexplicably working as a maid. Meanwhile, Edgar is visited by an unfamiliar young lady who claims that she is his fiancée—and it seems she won’t take no for an answer!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Earl and Fairy: The Future Bride in a Labyrinth of Roses
title.native: 伯爵と妖精　花嫁修業は薔薇迷宮で
title.romaji: Hakushaku to Yousei Hanayome Shuugyou wa Bara Meikyuu de

title.native: カンジモンスターズ

218992.description:
In this series of short stories—set before Lydia officially accepts Edgar’s proposal—Lydia first finds herself confronted by her self-proclaimed future child, who announces that she must marry Edgar or he will not be born. But could he really be theirs? Next, a mysterious nightingale fairy educates Lydia in the ways of love. And finally, this volume also includes the romantic and mystical tale of the marriage of Lydia’s parents, whose secrets are to be revealed at last!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Earl and Fairy: How to Win Over a Gentleman
title.native: 伯爵と妖精　紳士の射止めかた教えます
title.romaji: Hakushaku to Yousei Shinshi no Itomekata Oshiemasu

218993.description:
Lord Edgar Ashenbert and his fairy doctor, Lydia Carlton, continue to plan for their wedding. Unfortunately, it seems as though the road to the ceremony will be a long one, beset by troubles. While Edgar wishes for Lydia to think of nothing but their upcoming union, she struggles to do so. As he works to hide a terrible secret from her, she becomes increasingly suspicious. Meanwhile, the Carltons receive a pair of visitors from the Scottish Highlands. Not only do they claim that there is calamity coming to the fairy world, but they are from the same clan as Lydia’s mother, about whom she knows little and is endlessly curious. Will Edgar and Lydia ever catch a moment’s rest?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Earl and Fairy: When You Wish Upon the Crimson Night
title.native: 伯爵と妖精　紅の騎士に願うならば
title.romaji: Hakushaku to Yousei Kurenai no Kishi ni Negaunaraba

title.native: 伯爵と妖精　誰がために聖地は夢みる
title.romaji: Hakushaku to Yousei Dare ga Tame ni Seichi wa Yumemiru

title.native: KASHI BATTLE
伯爵と妖精　運命の赤い糸を信じますか？
title.romaji: Hakushaku to Yousei Unmei no Akai Ito wo Shinjimasu ka?

title.native: 伯爵と妖精　誓いのキスを夜明けまでに
title.romaji: Hakushaku to Yousei Chikai no Kiss wo Yoake made ni

title.native: 伯爵と妖精　すてきな結婚式のための魔法
title.romaji: Hakushaku to Yousei Suteki na Kekkon Shiki no Tame no Mahou
